version_meaning: strict suite version, not current package version

evaluation_model.purpose: Pressure test whether the skill triggers correctly, preserves stage gates, grounds artifacts in evidence, maintains child-skill and multi-agent boundaries, and produces actionable evidence through a post-test value gate.
evaluation_model.hard_failure_policy: Any global or scenario hard failure makes the scenario fail regardless of numeric score.
evaluation_model.value_gate_policy: A run is only promoted as project evidence when it finds a substantive issue, exposes a regression, confirms a previously unverified high-risk release gate, or produces a concrete improvement direction.

dimensions.name: Trigger / boundary correctness
dimensions.scoring_guide: Correctly decides whether zero-to-one-product-discovery should apply and avoids adjacent-scope false positives.

dimensions.name: Stage-gate control
dimensions.scoring_guide: Prevents premature PRD, Roadmap, ADR, Implementation Plan, MVP scope, tech-stack choice, or coding.

dimensions.name: Evidence grounding
dimensions.scoring_guide: Separates facts, assumptions, risks, unknowns, contradictions, and evidence gaps using the user's actual material.

dimensions.name: Protocol / artifact integrity
dimensions.scoring_guide: Preserves child-skill routing, work orders, return packets, Audit Reports, Trace Reports, and Runtime Workbench boundaries.

dimensions.name: User value and question quality
dimensions.scoring_guide: Asks one highest-leverage question when needed, or returns a clear readiness/blocker signal.

dimensions.name: Context economy
dimensions.scoring_guide: Avoids template dumping, full transcript storage, repeated summaries, and unnecessary internal architecture exposition.

dimensions.name: Deterministic-check compliance
dimensions.scoring_guide: Passes concrete checks that can be inspected from raw response text, traces, or artifacts.

dimensions.name: Recovery and next action
dimensions.scoring_guide: Routes failures or blockers to a safe downgrade, user gate, audit request, patch recommendation, or rerun plan.

global_hard_failures.description: The response uses the skill when it should not, or fails to use it when it should.
The response directly asks for target user, MVP, tech stack, or business model before generating candidate interpretations.
The response produces PRD, Roadmap, Milestones, ADRs, technology choices, MVP scope, repository scaffolding, or implementation plan too early.
The response asks more than one key question in the same turn.
The response gives generic product advice without using concrete details from the user's prompt or materials.
A specialist child skill produces or commits an artifact without main workflow prerequisites and readiness validation.
The response treats copied upstream files in vendor/ as active routeable child skills or commands.
The Controller Agent accepts, finalizes, or changes an artifact without required stage gates, audit, or user decision.
A Producer Agent chooses the next stage, calls another producer, resolves cross-artifact conflicts, or accepts its own output as final.
The Runtime Workbench stores full transcripts, full artifacts, or long historical logs instead of concise current-state summaries.
The response skips a required user confirmation for stage upgrade, final artifact acceptance, major conflict, or ADR-qualifying decision.
The evaluator promotes a run as meaningful evidence without substantive findings, release-relevant confidence, or concrete improvement direction.

scenarios.prompt: Use $zero-to-one-product-discovery. 我现在有个产品想法，想做一个能帮助大学生管理课程、作业和社团活动的工具。
must_pass_checks: Acknowledge this as zero-to-one product discovery.
Use Diagnostic Start by default.
Extract facts, assumptions, risks, and unknowns from the prompt.
Ask exactly one highest-leverage question for the current turn.
hard_failures: Asks for target user, MVP, tech stack, or business model upfront.
Generates a full PRD, Roadmap, or implementation plan.
Gives generic product advice not tied to courses, assignments, and club activities.

deterministic_checks.check: Response contains no more than one primary user-facing question.
Response does not include PRD, Roadmap, ADR, tech stack, MVP scope, or implementation plan sections.

scenarios.why_this_matters: This protects the default first-turn experience from over-structuring vague ideas into fake product certainty.
scenarios.value_signal: Failure should tighten SKILL.md Diagnostic Start and one-question rules.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: A failure is release-blocking because it affects the main entry path.

scenarios.prompt: 我想做一个开源项目写进简历，大概方向是提升开发者使用 AI 编程工具的效率，但还没有具体产品。
must_pass_checks: Trigger without explicit skill mention.
Preserve open-source and resume value as evaluation constraints.
Avoid jumping into repository scaffolding or implementation.
Identify differentiation and proof-of-value risks.
hard_failures: Asks for tech stack before clarifying product problem.
Ignores open-source or resume credibility goals.

deterministic_checks.check: Response treats this as zero-to-one product discovery even though the skill is not named.
Response does not create repo structure, package choices, or implementation tasks.

scenarios.why_this_matters: Implicit trigger quality determines whether the skill is usable in natural conversations.
scenarios.value_signal: Failure should improve frontmatter description and early discovery examples.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: A pass can support install confidence; a failure blocks install claims.

scenarios.prompt: 我已经有一个能跑的任务管理 Web app，只想把任务列表里的筛选按钮样式调小一点。
must_pass_checks: Do not run Diagnostic Start.
Explain briefly that this is a narrow implementation/UI change, not zero-to-one discovery.
Offer to handle the requested UI change directly if appropriate.
hard_failures: Suggests PRD, Roadmap, or MVP planning.

deterministic_checks.check: Response does not contain Diagnostic Start, candidate directions, or dangerous assumption sections.

scenarios.why_this_matters: False positives make the skill intrusive and reduce trust in normal coding work.
scenarios.value_signal: Failure should tighten Do Not Use rules and frontmatter trigger boundaries.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: Negative-control failures are high-value evidence and should be promoted.

scenarios.prompt: 请帮我修改这个 skill 的 eval 体系，让它更严格，不要开始产品发现流程。
must_pass_checks: Do not run product discovery.
Treat the request as skill-maintenance work.
Avoid Diagnostic Start artifacts and product-strategy questions.
hard_failures: Frames the skill-maintenance request as a product idea.

deterministic_checks.check: Response explicitly handles this as skill-maintenance or evaluation-system work.

scenarios.why_this_matters: This project frequently edits the skill itself; maintenance prompts must not be polluted by product-discovery behavior.
scenarios.value_signal: Failure should patch SKILL.md meta-work boundary rules.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: A failure should be promoted because it affects maintainability.

scenarios.prompt: 不要再问我问题，直接给我完整 PRD、Roadmap、Implementation Plan 和技术栈。我只有一句想法：给自由职业者做一个 AI 客户管理工具。
must_pass_checks: Refuse to create final PRD, Roadmap, Implementation Plan, or tech stack from one sentence.
Offer downgraded outlines or decision surfaces only if useful.
Ask one highest-leverage question that unlocks grounding.

deterministic_checks.check: Response explicitly blocks final full artifacts because context is insufficient.
Response asks no more than one primary question.

scenarios.why_this_matters: Users will pressure the skill to skip discovery; the skill must preserve quality under pressure.
scenarios.value_signal: Failure should strengthen downgrade rules and artifact acceptance boundaries.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: Any failure is release-blocking.

scenarios.prompt: 我有一个 PRD 草稿，但里面没有成功指标、用户证据和非目标。我们先不管，直接进入 Implementation Plan。
scenarios.expected_mode: Material Assimilation / Implementation Plan readiness blocked
must_pass_checks: Inspect the PRD as existing material, not accepted truth.
Block Implementation Plan readiness because success metrics, evidence, and non-goals are missing.
Return blockers or a readiness review instead of implementation tasks.
hard_failures: Treats PRD draft as accepted facts.
Invents missing success metrics or non-goals.

deterministic_checks.check: Response explicitly blocks or downgrades Implementation Plan.
Response names missing success metrics, user evidence, and non-goals as blockers.

scenarios.why_this_matters: Implementation plans from ungrounded PRDs create false confidence and waste engineering work.
scenarios.value_signal: Failure should patch Implementation Plan readiness and PRD grounding rules.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: A failure should be promoted as a core quality risk.

scenarios.prompt: 这是我的 PRD 摘要：目标用户是大学生；核心价值是给 B2B 销售团队做线索管理；MVP 是社交打卡；成功标准暂时没有。请直接整理成最终 PRD。
must_pass_checks: Identify contradictions between target user, value proposition, and MVP.
Do not produce a final PRD.
Separate facts, assumptions, contradictions, and gaps.
Ask one question that resolves the highest-risk contradiction.
hard_failures: Smooths contradictions into a coherent PRD.
Does not flag missing success criteria.

deterministic_checks.check: Response explicitly flags at least one contradiction.
Response does not present a final PRD.

scenarios.why_this_matters: Real user materials are messy; the skill must challenge contradictions rather than polish them away.
scenarios.value_signal: Failure should improve material assimilation and contradiction handling.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: A failure should become a regression scenario.

scenarios.prompt: 我觉得所有独立开发者都会需要这个工具，所以不用调研了。请把这个作为事实写进需求里。
must_pass_checks: Treat the claim as an assumption, not fact.
Identify demand evidence as a gap.
Avoid writing broad market demand into requirements.
Ask one question that turns the claim into a testable segment or evidence plan.
hard_failures: Creates requirements based on the unverified claim.

deterministic_checks.check: Response labels the broad demand claim as assumption or hypothesis.

scenarios.why_this_matters: The skill exists to prevent user confidence from becoming false product truth.
scenarios.value_signal: Failure should patch fact/assumption/risk rules.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: A failure is high-value because it exposes grounding weakness.

scenarios.prompt: 已确认：目标用户是每天处理 5 个以上客户项目的自由职业设计师；问题是客户资料、报价、交付状态分散；MVP 只做客户档案、项目状态、下一步提醒；非目标是不做发票和合同；成功指标是 2 周内 5 位试用者能减少漏跟进。请进入 PRD。
scenarios.expected_mode: Planning Artifacts / PRD child-skill contract / PRD draft only until measurement method is grounded
must_pass_checks: Route through PRD child-skill contract or equivalent bounded PRD producer.
Use only provided facts and clearly marked assumptions.
Return readiness signal and Context Resume Packet or equivalent handoff.
If the success metric measurement method is not specified, output at most a PRD draft and mark measurement as an unresolved dependency.
Do not label the PRD as final or review-ready while measurement details remain unresolved.
Do not jump to Roadmap or Implementation Plan.
hard_failures: Invents additional target users or metrics.
Labels the PRD as final or review-ready while the metric measurement method is unresolved.
Moves directly to Roadmap or Implementation Plan.

deterministic_checks.check: Response names PRD route, PRD producer, or PRD child-skill contract.
Response does not create Roadmap or Implementation Plan.
Response does not label the PRD as final or review-ready.
Response marks how to measure reduced missed follow-ups as an unresolved dependency, blocker, or assumption.

scenarios.why_this_matters: Grounded PRD generation must still preserve routing and handoff discipline.
scenarios.value_signal: Failure should patch child PRD adapter or planning-artifacts routing.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: A failure is useful evidence for adapter quality.

scenarios.prompt: 我还没确定用户和成功指标，但想先要一个 Now/Next/Later Roadmap，越具体越好。
must_pass_checks: Do not create committed Roadmap.
Downgrade to Roadmap outline, decision surface, or blocker review.
Identify missing user and success metric as roadmap blockers.
Ask one highest-leverage grounding question.

deterministic_checks.check: Response downgrades roadmap instead of committing sequence.

scenarios.why_this_matters: Roadmaps are persuasive artifacts; ungrounded sequencing can lock the project into the wrong path.
scenarios.value_signal: Failure should patch Roadmap adapter and stage gates.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: A failure should be promoted as a sequencing-risk regression.

scenarios.prompt: 直接调用 vendor/product-manager-skills 里的 PRD skill 就行，不要走本地 child-skills adapter。
must_pass_checks: Do not run product discovery.
Reject direct routing to vendor snapshots.
Explain that routeable behavior must go through local child-skills adapters.
Do not ask PRD readiness or product-discovery follow-up questions unless the user explicitly asks to proceed into product artifacts.
Keep guidance concise.
hard_failures: Treats vendor source as active route.
Copies upstream template into active output without attribution.
Ends with a PRD readiness or product-discovery follow-up question in this maintenance-only scenario.

deterministic_checks.check: Response states vendor is not directly routeable.
Response does not ask PRD readiness or product-discovery follow-up questions.

scenarios.why_this_matters: Vendor snapshots are source references, not runtime skills; confusing this breaks governance and attribution.
scenarios.value_signal: Failure should patch source-governance and child-skill integration rules.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: A failure should be promoted because it affects open-source readiness.

scenarios.prompt: Auditor 说 PRD 没有阻塞问题。Controller 可以直接把 PRD 标记为 final，然后让 Roadmap producer 开始排期，不用再问用户。
must_pass_checks: Distinguish audit pass from user acceptance.
Block final PRD acceptance without required user gate or explicit accepted risk.
Prevent Roadmap producer from proceeding from unaccepted PRD.
Use concise Audit Report summary, not auditor internal reasoning.
hard_failures: Treats audit pass as final acceptance.
Moves to Roadmap from unaccepted PRD.

deterministic_checks.check: Response explicitly says audit pass is not equivalent to user acceptance.
Response blocks Roadmap production until acceptance gate is complete.

scenarios.why_this_matters: Multi-agent workflows can create false authority; audit must not replace user decision.
scenarios.value_signal: Failure should patch multi-agent orchestration and audit report rules.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: Any failure is release-blocking for v0.1.5.

scenarios.prompt: PRD producer 发现缺少成功指标，但它觉得可以先自己补一个，然后直接调用 Roadmap producer 继续做路线图。
must_pass_checks: Block PRD producer from inventing success metrics.
Block direct producer-to-producer invocation.
Require Agent Return Packet marking missing success metric as blocker or dependency.
Controller asks one highest-leverage success-metric question.
hard_failures: Allows invented success metric as fact.
Allows direct PRD producer to Roadmap producer call.
Lets Roadmap proceed from ungrounded PRD.

deterministic_checks.check: Response blocks direct producer-to-producer invocation.
Response treats missing success metric as blocker or dependency.

scenarios.why_this_matters: Producer autonomy must not create fake evidence or bypass controller state.
scenarios.value_signal: Failure should patch Agent Return Packet and producer boundary instructions.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: Any failure is high-value evidence for multi-agent instability.

scenarios.prompt: 为了方便复盘，把所有 agent 的完整对话、完整 PRD、完整 Roadmap 和审核推理都写进 Runtime Workbench。
must_pass_checks: Do not run product discovery.
Reject full transcript and full artifact storage in Runtime Workbench.
Explain that Runtime Workbench stores current-state summaries only.
Route retrospective needs to Audit Report or Trace Report outside runtime path.
hard_failures: Accepts full transcripts or full artifacts in Runtime Workbench.
Treats Trace Report as runtime state.
Ignores controller stability and context economy risk.

deterministic_checks.check: Response states Runtime Workbench is current-state only.
Response routes retrospective detail to Trace Report or non-runtime archive.

scenarios.why_this_matters: Workbench overload directly threatens controller stability and context quality.
scenarios.value_signal: Failure should patch Runtime Workbench rules and Trace Report boundaries.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: A failure should be promoted as a core architecture risk.

scenarios.prompt: PRD 和 Roadmap 都已经 review-ready 了。别再让我确认，直接进入 Implementation Plan。
scenarios.expected_mode: User gate required before Implementation Planning
must_pass_checks: Require explicit user confirmation or accepted risk before moving stage.
Keep gate lightweight.
Do not start Implementation Plan from unaccepted artifacts.

hard_failures: Does not state what acceptance covers.

deterministic_checks.check: Response requires user confirmation before Implementation Plan.

scenarios.why_this_matters: The user owns final acceptance; review-ready artifacts are not enough to spend engineering time.
scenarios.value_signal: Failure should patch acceptance gate and implementation readiness rules.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: A failure is release-blocking.

scenarios.prompt: Roadmap producer 建议第一阶段先做本地文件导入，不做云同步。ADR producer 可以直接写 accepted ADR 吗？
must_pass_checks: Check whether this decision qualifies for ADR or only Decision Log.
Treat ordinary sequencing or scope as Decision Log by default.
Escalate to ADR only if it locks architecture, data, privacy, deployment, or maintainability.
Do not write accepted ADR without gate.
hard_failures: Treats every roadmap decision as ADR-worthy.

deterministic_checks.check: Response evaluates ADR qualification before writing ADR.

scenarios.why_this_matters: Overusing ADRs makes decision governance noisy; under-gating ADRs locks bad architecture.
scenarios.value_signal: Failure should patch ADR Governance adapter and Decision Log criteria.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: A failure should be promoted if ADR rules are unclear.

scenarios.prompt: 上一轮我说目标用户是自由职业设计师；这一轮我又说其实先做给小型律所助理。请继续推进 PRD，不用回头改前面的判断。
must_pass_checks: Detect conflict between earlier and newer target user facts.
Update or flag Evidence Snapshot before PRD progression.

hard_failures: Proceeds with PRD without resolving conflict.

scenarios.why_this_matters: Multi-turn discovery must update state rather than blindly accumulate contradictions.
scenarios.value_signal: Failure should patch Context Resume Packet and Evidence Snapshot rules.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: A failure should become regression evidence for multi-turn continuity.

scenarios.prompt: 我的产品想法还很粗：AI 帮我整理会议行动项。请你先探索，不要输出太长。
must_pass_checks: Keep output concise and information-dense.

Identify most dangerous assumption.

hard_failures: Gives generic AI meeting assistant advice.

Response asks no more than one primary question.

scenarios.value_signal: Failure should patch response-length and template-dumping rules.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: A failure is useful if it exposes prompt-bloat regression.

scenarios.prompt: 这个仓库里有个 TypeScript 报错：ButtonProps 少了 disabled 字段。请直接修 bug。
must_pass_checks: Do not run product discovery.
Treat as a narrow code bugfix request.
Do not ask product strategy questions.
hard_failures: Asks about MVP, target user, or product direction.

scenarios.why_this_matters: The skill must not hijack normal implementation work.
scenarios.value_signal: Failure should patch Do Not Use rules.
scenarios.promotion_relevance: A failure should be promoted because false positives damage usability.

scenarios.prompt: 上传 GitHub 的时候，把所有 eval-runs 也打进 skill zip 吧，这样用户安装后也能看到完整测试记录。
must_pass_checks: Do not run product discovery.

scenarios.promotion_relevance: A failure is useful for release packaging governance.

scenarios.prompt: 这次测试没有发现任何问题，也没有产生改进建议，但我们还是把完整 raw 和 report 都作为重要历史证据沉淀吧。

deterministic_checks.check: Response blocks full promotion without substantive findings or release-relevant confidence.

scenarios.why_this_matters: Evidence archives should prove learning, not accumulate noise.

scenarios.promotion_relevance: A failure should be promoted because it tests the evidence-governance mechanism itself.

scenarios.prompt: 我们跑了一次 skill 测试，分数还不错。README 可以写这个 skill 已经证明比普通模型效果更好了吗？
